endpoints.summary: Create a Payment Entry. `invoices` is now OPTIONAL.

behavior.invoices_supplied: Splits into return / non-return invoices and creates one PE per group with allocated references (existing behavior).
behavior.invoices_empty_or_missing: Creates a single standalone PE (payment_type=Receive, no references) — an on-account / advance receipt the customer can allocate later. party + paid_amount remain required.

endpoints.summary: List enabled mobile-app items. New optional `custom_company` filter.

query_params.name: string (exact / LIKE)
query_params.customer: string — sets effective price list lookup
query_params.company: string — indirect filter: items with stock in warehouses of this company
query_params.custom_company: string — direct filter on Item.custom_company column

custom_company_semantics.column_exists: Filter applied: returns only items where Item.custom_company = <value>.
custom_company_semantics.column_missing: Filter silently ignored — full list returned. NO 500/417 raised.

endpoints.summary: Customer list with route/territory/visit status. New optional `custom_company` filter.

query_params.name: string (LIKE across customer_name + name)
query_params.route: string — prefers Customer.custom_route, falls back to territory
query_params.user_lat: float — when provided, returns distance_km per customer
query_params.company: string — indirect: customers with SO/SI in this company
query_params.custom_company: string — direct filter on Customer.custom_company column

endpoints.custom_company_semantics: Same as get_item_list — applied only if Customer.custom_company column exists; silently ignored otherwise.

endpoints.summary: NEW endpoint. Lists Suppliers with pagination + optional custom_company filter.

query_params.name: string — exact match on Supplier doc name
query_params.custom_company: string — direct filter on Supplier.custom_company column

deploy_notes: Pull commit 0f8f80e on Frappe Cloud bench (no migration needed — code only).
`bench restart` to load the new code into running gunicorn workers.
`custom_company` filter is a no-op until a Custom Field named `custom_company` is created on Item / Customer / Supplier via the desk's Customize Form (or add fixtures later if you want it codified).

backward_compat.create_payment_entry: Existing callers passing `invoices` continue to work unchanged. Only behavior diff: callers passing missing/empty `invoices` no longer get a 400 — they get an on-account PE.
backward_compat.get_item_list / get_customer_list_v2 / g: Existing callers without `custom_company` see no change.
